_archetype.origin: Light & Wonder (formerly Bally / Scientific Games) — 'Blazing 777 Triple Double Jackpot Wild — Nudging Stacks' family
_archetype.chassis_reference: Classic 3-reel 9-line stepper + bidirectional stacked-wild nudge mechanic + Asian-market collect-to-wheel feature add-on
_archetype.chassis_reference_rtp_benchmark: 94% (default variant of Blazing 777); LHS uses 95% red line per project_slot_designer_mode_rtp_invariants
_archetype.rwb_par_sheet_reference: https://wizardofodds.com/games/slots/appendix/6/ — Red White & Blue PAR sheet (Wizard of Odds, Michael Shackleford). Use for asymmetric reel pattern inspiration: Reel 1 has 1 Red7 / Reel 2 has 3 Red7 / Reel 3 has 1 Red7 (kill / anchor / kill). M279 v2 reverses: Reel 2 is the kill reel (low high7 count), Reel 1+3 are lead reels (more high7).
_archetype.asymmetric_design: Reel 2 = 'kill' reel (heavy blank, 1 high7 vs 3 on lead reels, no single wild2x/wild3x). Reel 1+3 = 'lead' reels (mirror pattern). Forces top jackpot path through Reel 2 = single reel constraint = top JP rate controllable via Reel 2 high7/wild density independent of lead reels.
modifications_vs_archetype: 5 jackpot tiers (pay_id 101 = 250×, 102 = 150×, 103 = 50×, 104 = 15×) — fixed credits per machineconfig/M279Cfg.txt rewards block.
Collect-to-wheel feature (mode 1: meter 1000 → wheel 12 cell pay; mode 5: meter 150 → wheel ×7 win scale).
BuffCollectionMap (ST=102) UI overlay marker, no analyzer impact.
_archetype.confidence: high (paytable + spin_type + wheel cells + stack layout reverse-engineered from cfg + rawdata + user-confirmed Excel reference)

_invariants: Wild stack atomic trio (wild_up / wild2x_mid / wild_down) at adjacent strip positions in this exact order (top → bot). Trio appears once per reel at position 28-30. Phase 5 SA tuner must treat as atomic super-stop.
Strips byte-identical across modes 1/2/5/7 (project_slot_designer_strips_identical_across_modes hard rule). Different modes have different weights but SAME symbol-at-position layout.
Mode 5 base weights byte-identical to mode 2 weights (cross-mode invariant); mode 5 differs only via _m279_overrides feature parameters.
Reel 2 high7 count <= 0.5 × min(Reel 1, Reel 3) high7 count (asymmetric kill-reel red line).
Reel 2 carries NO single wild2x or wild3x (these only on lead reels) — forces wild jackpot pay 101/102 to require lead-reel anchors.
No reroll_blocks (M37-specific mechanic; M279 doesn't block any wild combo from paying).
Each reel ≤ 70% blank stops by count (DESIGN_PHILOSOPHY §3 blank cap headroom; current: Reel 1 60%, Reel 2 70%, Reel 3 63%).
_near_miss_design: Wild stack anchor at position 28-30 of each reel produces partial-visible stack ~12% per spin → MoveSpin trigger.
Stack edge stops (positions 27 + 31, the 'b-after-P' / 'b-before-stack') sit between cluster pattern blanks and stack, designed weight low → triggering rate kept near 12% target.
Reel 2 low high7 + stack-only-mid-pay design: when 2 of 3 reels show wild stack on top row, Reel 2 needing high7 is the 'last symbol' near-miss (Harrigan PWDF principle adapted).
_v2_design_notes: 2026-04-28 v2: re-designed from v1 with proper numerical anchoring per DESIGN.md.
Asymmetric per-reel symbol distribution (lead/kill/lead) replacing v1's uniform-counts.
Stop count per reel: 60 (kept from v1).
Reel 1 (lead): 36 blank + 4 low7 + 3 mid7 + 3 high7 + 3 5bar + 4 bar + 1 wild + 1 wild2x + 1 wild3x + 1 stack(×3 trio) = 60
Reel 2 (kill): 42 blank + 3 low7 + 2 mid7 + 1 high7 + 3 5bar + 4 bar + 1 wild + 0 wild2x + 0 wild3x + 1 stack(×3 trio) = 60
Reel 3 (lead-mirror): 38 blank + 4 low7 + 3 mid7 + 3 high7 + 3 5bar + 3 bar + 1 wild + 0 wild2x + 0 wild3x + 1 stack(×3 trio) = 59 (+1 blank for 60)
Phase 4 tuner adjusts per-stop weights (not stop counts) for RTP/hit/bucket targets per mode.
Phase 5 joint SA: stack trio is atomic super-stop — DO NOT split during shuffle.
